Messages.Author: TorranceCircle
Messages.Body:
Why is this card not more popular? It costs a blood but it it lets you not tap for blocking or lets you untap, with +1 intercept. Is it the do not replace clause?

With the popularity of Eyes of Argus, i wonder why I don't see more RtW played.

Read the Winds

Reaction
Animalism & Auspex

Do not replace until after this action.
+1 intercept. This vampire doesn't tap for successfully blocking this action.
Only usable by a tapped vampire. This vampire untaps and attempts to block with +1 intercept, even if intercept is not yet needed.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> KevinM wrote:
> If the guy that played the Pentex on Goratrix wants to keep all his minions untapped and not ousting his prey while I'm repeatedly taking lots and lots of actions to remove Pentex, I'm fine with that trade-off!
>
Well, he often need only keep zero or one minion for that, depending on the amount of wake or majesty he have. And since your non-goratrix minion are likely to end in torpor after the first block, it can be fast. And if he is your predator, it's not like he have a hope to bleed you without the pentex anyway

Don't forget that your non-goratrix minion not only are easy to block, but easy to kill too.

Some star deck can have somewhat stealthy sidekick and/or that can do something in combat, the foratrix wall is not one of them. The best bet being Mirror walk, which weaken significantly against anything non-pentex.
